# openaiagents_environment_template (Data Source)

Look up an environment template by ID. Confidential fields are not returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openaiagents_environment_template" "skills" {
  name = "report-env"
}

data "openaiagents_environment_template" "selected" {
  id = openaiagents_environment_template.skills.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Remote template ID.

### Read-Only

- `capability_directories` (List of String) Capability directories.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix create timestamp.
- `env_keys` (List of String) Environment variable names, if the API returns them. Values are never returned.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `object` (String) Object type.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix update timestamp.
